about: Files moved here byte for byte from another code tree by tools/move-code-between-trees: each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. Only import paths and the listed calls differ.

calls.means: The same canonical JSON (decision-store.mjs held a copy of decision-records.mjs canonical, which it imports itself), from the module that has no record engine behind it, so a tool row that keeps messages over the records door (tools/conversations tool:import-my-conversations-from-a-source) can pack messages.mjs without the engine.
This repository is public and holds made-up data only: a real person's first name used as a test's sample owner becomes a made-up one. Nothing else in the file changes.
This repository is public and holds made-up data only: a real person's first name in a test's note about whose store a measure came from becomes a made-up one. Nothing else in the file changes.

files.adapted: the compiled identity is browse-and-upload-my-files loadChunking's Identity, loaded without the retired restartable wrapper, and readHandoffResultSource is shared-code's; every assertion is the old one
the held workshop-tasks-for-tests taskQuestions is stood in over the same empty task list; every assertion is the old one

the three tests over check-uses' own functions run as they were; seven that made decisions through the retired DecisionEngine and routes are left out, decide-with-a-method's work-screen test checking the same view over records
countingHost comes from test/counting-host-for-tests.mjs, the old helper without its PersonStore; every assertion is the old one
makeLists is keep-lists-of-rows'; the eight tests that sent words through the retired arrival door (src/inbound.mjs) are left out, as no running code ingests through resolveKeptMessage
record-sync comes from tools/record-log; the search-index steps and the kept-history rewrite test are not carried, their owners being trillion-rust record_store search.rs and history_archive.rs
the erase_record tool-row test runs as it was; the PersonStore /records/erase test is not carried, the route being trillion-rust src/record_value/account_routes.rs
the PersonStore.activityTrace test is left out, as no running code has that entry point; the other four are the old ones
activity rows come from see-what-my-ais-did; the tests through the retired MCP handler and Spaces route are left out; the other six are the old ones
the assertions that called through the retired Durable Object stub wrapper (resource-host.mjs hostOf) are left out; every other assertion is the old one
the registry is set-up-my-account's failure-codes.json; the calls through the retired MCP handler are left out, the payloadOf assertions kept
the outcomeCorrection test runs as it was; three tests through the retired PersonStore's /cases routes are left out, as no running code serves them
the cards are read from this tool's records/workshop-*.json and every tool folder's tool-rows.json, where the Workshop's rows live now; every assertion is the old one
the instrumented kept-runs copy is imported from a scratch folder with its one relative import made absolute, in place of the old in-memory loader; every assertion is the old one
the retired arrival door is stood in by its one messages.record call, listen.mjs is run-on-a-persons-computer's, and the microphone state lives in a scratch folder; every assertion is the old one
agents and delivery come from shared-code, taskQuestions is stood in, and the test reading the retired person-store.mjs source is left out; every other assertion is the old one

the client catalogue and report-progress come from set-up-my-account and run-on-a-persons-computer, and the retired setup answer's command checks read this tool's MCP row; its default-clients check is left out, the row taking the apps from the caller

the sealedLogPage test over this tool's record-log store and a rows-as-consumed counter; the own-AI routing tests and the retired PersonStore's carry-in and full-store archival tests are left out, as no running code does that work

hand-work-to-ais agentRecordStore's wake index over this tool's record-log store; the retired own-AI routing's answers (runner().nextDue, its pages) are left out, so the first test runs a fixed number of cold wakes
